title: Define auditable translation profile records
description: Define the versioned auditable shape of a physically validated translation profile while preventing creation or persistence of such a profile until the unresolved evidence gate and approved policy requirements are genuinely satisfied.
acceptanceCriteria: The schema carries exact setup, loading, configuration, layout revision, fingerprint, source observations, policy version, sample count, diagnostics, language, and disclosed x/y parameters
Every evidence and assumption reference is immutable, resolvable, and reproducible
The creation boundary requires successful TASK-102 through TASK-104 outcomes
Under current blocked conditions no physically validated profile record can be created or saved

steps.details: Specify versioned evidence references, approved policy identity, sample count, diagnostics, language class, and millimetre translation disclosures on the exact TASK-68 assumptions.
Require all source observations and compatibility assumptions to resolve exactly and reject mixed layouts, setups, configurations, fingerprints, or policy versions.
Place construction and repository writes behind successful physical gate, qualification, and language outcomes; current execution must return blocked.
Validate representative schema fixtures and prove absent policy, insufficient evidence, demo data, or incompatibility yields no persisted profile.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; define schema validation and blocked construction only.
BLOCKED: no profile instance may claim physical validation until real evidence and policy resolve issues 13, 07, and 09.
A schema fixture demonstrates structure, not existence of a valid profile.
